After taking kratom for a few years, this is the best method of prep that I have discovered. It's not quite an extract, and it's more effective than plain leaf, for me. First, add 30-40 grams of kratom into a cereal-sized glass bowl. Add the juice of 2-3 limes, enough to make it more liquid than paste, but not by much. It will take a few minutes of alternately stirring a few times and waiting, while the hydrophobic kratom powder draws in the acids of the juice. After it is thoroughly saturated, stir in 1 cup of cold water. I use bottled spring or distilled. Once mixed, put it in the freezer, overnight or 8-10 hours. A lid is not necessary. When you take it out, you will probably notice a lump extruding from part of the surface, red in color. This is normal, and a sign that the kratom used was of decent quality. After allowing to thaw somewhat, add it to a nonheated pan and set temp to low-med on the stovetop. Add in 1 more cup of water. I add 1 tablespoon of coconut oil and 1 spoon of avocado/olive/grapeseed/veg oil, whatever I have available. Some alks are fat soluable, and this helps draw them out of the now-burst (thanks to freezing) cell walls of the plant. Heat just below simmering, where it is evaporating but not bubbling at all. Let it stew for 15-20 minutes, stirring frequently enough that the plant matter doesn't settle to the bottom and burn, or that the heat becomes concentrated enough to start bubbling. After this, remove from heat and allow to cool. Now you should have a soup of somewhat extracted alkaloids and plant matter. This freezing and heating makes most of the alks previously stuck inside hard to digest plant matter free-floating in the liquid. I store what should now be around 2 cups or 500 ml of stew in a 24oz glass salsa bottle, without separating the liquid from the solids, in the fridge. I use 40-50 ml doses, about the size of a small rx pill bottle, mixed with 1 gram of raw powder and 8oz of orange juice. While technically only using 3-4 grams of kratom, the effects are much stronger, hit much quicker, and last much longer than raw powder alone would. Dosages should, of course, be adjusted to the lowest amount needed for effectiveness.
